preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The length of the string is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total length of all strings does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 or a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of symbols to erase to make the string a palindrome.
